statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Nasdaq futures are closed for the weekend, so no live mean-reversion failure is observable; Tail is low while rates, energy costs, and Iran escalation keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The current closed-market state has low Tail because persistent directional structure cannot be observed; known rate, inflation, and geopolitical risks remain reflected in Stress and reopening uncertainty.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rate and geopolitical stress remains extreme
body: Friday's 162,000 payroll gain lifted Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations, while U.S. equities closed lower and semiconductors remained comparatively strong. Nasdaq futures are now closed. New Iran escalation rhetoric and impaired Hormuz traffic raise reopening-gap uncertainty without establishing a current one-way price path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hours, Tail moved from WATCH overnight into low bands, stayed near WATCH around payrolls, rose to 28% during the delayed downside leg at 16:00 UTC, eased on retracement, returned to 27% late in the cash session, and fell back to 19% once the weekend closure removed live path evidence.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain entirely within the weekend closed-market interval. Tail stays low because no new Nasdaq price path can form; Stress remains high-to-extreme from rates, inflation, oil, and geopolitical gap risk, while confidence gradually declines as Friday's market structure ages.
